meta.title: THE HER × OMID — A partnership built around possibilities
meta.description: The Her understands the woman behind the business. Omid focuses on the system behind the business.

s1.headline: A WORLD OF BUSINESS WOMEN.
s1.subheadline: Every woman builds a business in her own way.
s1.body: The Her understands the woman behind the business. This partnership is about understanding what sits behind it — the systems, decisions, experiences and opportunities that can move it forward.

s2.headline: Behind every ambitious woman, there is a different business.
s2.body: A founder may be building a brand, scaling sales, launching a product, or creating a business that gives her more freedom. The ambition may be shared. The system never is.

s3.headline: Different businesses. Different problems.
s3.subheadline: Growth rarely starts with the same question twice.
s3.body: One business needs demand. Another needs conversion. Another needs a stronger digital experience. The right response begins by understanding the problem before choosing the solution.

problems.title: More leads
problems.line: Reaching the right people at the right moment.

problems.title: Better conversion
problems.line: Helping more visitors take the next step.

problems.title: A better website
problems.line: Turning digital presence into business infrastructure.

problems.title: Better data
problems.line: Making decisions from signals, not assumptions.

problems.title: AI & automation
problems.line: Removing repetitive work and creating leverage.

problems.title: A digital product
problems.line: Turning expertise into a scalable experience.

s4.headline: So why should they all receive the same solution?
s4.subheadline: The problem should define the solution.
s4.body: There is no universal growth playbook. Sometimes the answer is marketing. Sometimes it is experience, data, technology, or a new digital product. The work starts with finding what actually matters.

s5.headline: The Her understands the woman. Omid focuses on the system.
s5.body: The Her brings the human understanding: ambition, identity, business and vision. Omid brings the systems perspective: growth, data, marketing, digital experience and AI.

s6.headline: DATA + MARKETING + EXPERIENCE + AI
s6.subheadline: Connected disciplines create a stronger growth system.
s6.body: Data reveals what is happening. Marketing creates demand. Experience turns attention into action. AI creates leverage. Connected together, they become one engine built around the business problem.

s7.headline: “We need more sales.”
s7.subheadline: Before adding traffic, understand where the system breaks.
s7.body: A request is rarely the diagnosis. We trace the journey from attention to revenue, identify the constraint, then design the response around it.

diagnostic.title: Offer
diagnostic.question: Is the value clear and relevant?

diagnostic.title: Trust
diagnostic.question: Is there enough confidence to act?

diagnostic.title: Experience
diagnostic.question: Is the journey simple and persuasive?

diagnostic.title: Data
diagnostic.question: Can we see what is actually working?

cases.headline: “We have traffic. But not enough sales.”
cases.subheadline: More traffic may not be the answer.
cases.diagnosis: The opportunity may sit between the visit and the purchase: offer clarity, trust, landing-page experience, conversion and follow-up.
cases.response: Audit the funnel, strengthen the experience, clarify the offer, improve conversion points and establish the measurement needed to learn what works.
cases.keyLine: Growth does not always need more traffic. Sometimes it needs a better system.

cases.headline: “Our business is growing. But our digital presence isn't.”
cases.subheadline: A growing business needs a digital experience that keeps pace.
cases.diagnosis: The opportunity may be bigger than a redesign: positioning, UX, UI, content structure, development and measurement need to work as one.
cases.response: Define the digital strategy, shape the user journey, design the interface, build the experience and connect it to measurable business outcomes.
cases.keyLine: A website should not only represent the business. It should move it forward.

cases.headline: “We're growing. But everything still depends on people.”
cases.subheadline: Growth becomes fragile when every process stays manual.
cases.diagnosis: The opportunity may lie in workflows, reporting, CRM, data flows and repetitive operations that can be redesigned or automated.
cases.response: Map the workflow, identify high-value automation opportunities, connect the data and introduce AI where it creates practical leverage.
cases.keyLine: AI should not replace the business. It should make the business more capable.

s9.headline: Built through years of growth work.
s9.subheadline: Experience across performance, acquisition, conversion, data and digital.
s9.body: A track record built across different growth environments — from acquisition and SEO to conversion, analytics and campaign optimization.

s10.headline: What if The Her could offer more — without becoming more?
s10.subheadline: An extended digital capability, available when the business needs it.
s10.body: Omid can work alongside The Her as a growth and digital partner — directly, within client projects, or quietly behind the scenes. The Her keeps the relationship. The capability expands.

s11.headline: Let’s explore what we could build together.
s11.subheadline: Not a fixed service. A partnership built around possibilities.
s11.body: When the right people, perspective and capabilities come together, the solution can be shaped around the business — not forced into a template.

footer.tagline: Different businesses. Different problems. One partner. Many possibilities.
